cases.title: The four first-party MCP servers handshake, list tools, and pass the suite (12 checks)
cases.notes: 12/12: 4 servers handshake, tools/list, tools/call; unknown method -> JSON-RPC error.

cases.title: Checkpoint snapshot -> agent mutation -> content-hash diff -> undo restores byte-identical
cases.notes: snapshot->mutate->diff(M/+/-)->undo restores byte-identical; equal-size edit + id-collision regression covered.

cases.title: The fs MCP server is read-only and refuses any path escaping its scoped root
cases.notes: fs server exposes only list_dir/read_file; ../ traversal refused; in-scope read OK.

cases.title: Firebreak: system read-only, only the workspace writable, /etc and $HOME and /usr writes blocked
cases.notes: 12/12 containment checks: workspace writable; /etc, /usr, HOME read-only; verified with installed /usr/bin binaries.

cases.title: Firebreak: --net none cuts the network and credential variables are scrubbed by default
cases.notes: --net none leaves only loopback (1 iface) vs host interfaces when allowed; OPENAI_API_KEY scrubbed by default; --keep-secrets opt-in.

cases.title: Firebreak takes a pre-run checkpoint and writes a session audit manifest; undo reverses the whole session
cases.notes: pre-run checkpoint + .session manifest written; run->undo restores clobbered file and removes the agent's added file.

cases.title: shadowfetch-fireline builds, installs, and every tool runs from /usr/bin as installed
cases.notes: shadowfetch-fireline_3.0.0-1_all.deb installs; all three CLIs + MCP servers run from /usr/bin; deps python3+bubblewrap only.

cases.title: AI Ignition recommends an Apache-2.0 model that fits the detected VRAM at every tier (CPU..48GB)
cases.notes: Recommender fits at CPU/2/4/6/8/10/12/16/24/48/128 GB, always Apache-2.0, CPU capped at 4GB weights; plan rejects unknown ids; catalog complete.

cases.title: Source, ShellCheck, syntax, secret and retired-runtime gates pass for the 3.0.0 tree
cases.notes: SOURCE_GATE_PASSED: 69 behavior tests, ShellCheck 57 scripts, gitleaks tree+history, desktop validation, retired-runtime scan.

cases.title: Every 3.0.0 binary + corresponding source package builds into a freshly signed Umbra repo
cases.notes: 16 binary / 14 source packages built into a freshly signed Umbra repo (reprepro allowlist passed); installed package contract verified inside the ISO.

cases.title: ISO structure, checksum, detached signature verify; squashfs within the 4 GiB ceiling
cases.notes: ISO_GATE_PASSED: sha256 110b0d075e699a05…, size 3967508480B, 3.72GB squashfs (575MB headroom), BIOS+UEFI hybrid, detached sig verifies, 15 exact Shadowfetch packages incl. fireline, no retired runtime/downloader.

cases.title: Final ISO reaches the live Plasma desktop in BIOS and UEFI
cases.notes: Live ISO boots BIOS+UEFI to Plasma 6; captures of Welcome, Guide/System Passport, Control Center, Phoenix, installer and the Fireline tools running live.

cases.title: Clean UEFI Btrfs and BIOS encrypted installs survive reboot and health checks
cases.notes: Clean UEFI Btrfs install (GPT+ESP, @/@home/@snapshots); 16 install steps rc=0; live user removed; cold-boots from disk to login as the created user on hostname backfire; shadowfetch/fireline tools present and executable on the installed system.
